mentions.name: dweb-sched (iOS schedule app)
mentions.description: An iOS schedule app built with the author's experimental native Rust UI framework. It has full native calendar integration: favoriting a session automatically adds it to the iOS calendar, and un-favoriting removes it. The app looks and feels completely native and uses taffy, a pure Rust implementation of CSS flexbox and grid, for layout.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Here’s a little ios schedule app I made with it:

https://github.com/josephg/dweb-sched

It’s got full native calendar integration - so if you want you can favorite a session and it’ll automatically add the session to your calendar in ios. (Or un-favorite to remove).
mentions.author: josephg
